correctness.rationale: The source clamp and forgetting state give the exact ratio recursion \(q_{t+1}=\min\{1,(1+1/\tau)q_t/c_t^2\}\). Under the stated source-relevant parameter range \(0<c_t<1\), so lock is finite and invariant. The post-lock dimensionless recurrence has reciprocal increments converging to \(2A\), which proves the exact asymptotic constant.

value.rationale: L4 is specifically designed to compute a fresh loss-based step each iteration, and the additive denominator constant is introduced as a numerical safeguard. The theorem shows that this seemingly innocuous safeguard eventually determines the exact convergence class on the canonical convex quadratic, while the practical minimum-loss tracker becomes irrelevant after a provably finite transient. The result therefore separates transient adaptation from the true late-stage bottleneck and quantifies the source defaults.
